mapper.sql: id, msg_id, client_msg_id, sender_id, receiver_id, receiver_type, msg_type, content, extra_json, media_meta_json, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message (id, msg_id, client_msg_id, sender_id, receiver_id, receiver_type, msg_type, content, extra_json, media_meta_json, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{msgId}, #{clientMsgId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverType}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{extraJson}, #{mediaMetaJson}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET status = #{status}, extra_json = #{extraJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_message WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM t_message WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM t_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND client_msg_id = #{clientMsgId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET status = #{newStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND status < #{newStatus} AND status != 4 AND deleted = 0
